title: Principal Virtualization Engineer
description:
**At Visteon, the work we do is both relevant and recognized**
—not just by our organization, but by our peers, by industry-leading brands, and by millions of drivers around the world.
**That’s YOUR work.**
**And, as a truly global technology leader in the mobility space, focused on building cross-functional AND
**cross-cultural**
teams, we connect you with people who help you grow.**
****So here, whatever we do is not a job. It’s a mission.**
As a multi-billion-dollar leader of disruptive change in the industry, we are shaping the future, while enabling a cleaner environment. No other industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place.**
****Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution.****
**Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.**
**And our team is ready for YOU. To show the world what you can do.**
****Detailed description:****

* Develop and execute SIL test plans and test cases for embedded systems.
* Collaborate with software development teams to understand the architecture and interfaces.
* Develop the plant model to help evaluate the virtual SW.
* Optimize and enhance SIL environment and testing tools for improved efficiency.
* Participate in model, simulation, design reviews and provide feedback on potential risks and improvements.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices in testing and validation
* Define the entry and exit criteria for SIL, across levels of virtualization.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

****Key Experience required:****

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Master’s preferred)
* 8-10+ years of experience in combination of Software Development, Modeling, simulation, virtualization and tests.
* Hands-on experience in AUTOSAR based SW architecture, including middleware.
* Hands-on experience in modeling tools, like MATLAB Simulink, Simscape , ASCET, System Desk, etc. (Extensive exp FMU’s, including on Co-Sim and Model exchange)
* Hands on experience on one or more of the following : VEOS, Silver, vVirtualTarget, ISOLAR EVE, QEMU. (Any tool migration experience would be an added advantage)
* Strong knowledge of Automation Framework Tools & Scripting Languages (Python, CAPL, Automation desk, etc.)
* Strong automotive domain knowledge (Cockpit electronics along with Battery management Systems preferred)
* Hands on experience with Linux, Docker - Containerization, KVM, VM's etc
* Expertise in across the levels of virtualization, from L1 to L4 and with both Open and closed loop simulation.
* Expertise in MIL/SIL setups preferred. PIL would be great value addition.
* Strong experience with Automotive buses such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet etc.,
* Strong experience with Test Management tools such as X-RAY, HP Quality Center, etc.,
* Experience in Agile/SCRUM Ceremonies
* Understanding or awareness of ASAM XiL

****More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future****
**Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.**
****Company Culture****
**Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.**
****About Visteon****
**Visteon is a global technology company serving the mobility industry, dedicated to creating a more enjoyable, connected and safe driving experience. The company’s platforms leverage proven, scalable hardware and software solutions that enable the digital, electric, and autonomous evolution of our global automotive customers. Visteon products align with key industry trends and include digital instrument clusters, displays, Android-based infotainment systems, domain controllers, advanced driver assistance systems and battery management systems. The company is headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, and has approximately 10,000 employees at more than 40 facilities in 18 countries. Visteon reported sales of approximately $2.8 billion and booked $5.1 billion of new business in 2021.**

title: Pen Testing - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights that help clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape and technology environment as we partner with them to transform their businesses.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for leading offensive security engagements and helping clients identify, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystem.
  
  

* Lead penetration testing workstreams across web, API, mobile, thick-client, network, cloud, and infrastructure environments.
* Design and execute manual and automated security assessments, validate findings, and develop remediation recommendations.
* Perform secure code reviews, application security architecture reviews, and threat modeling to identify design and implementation risks.
* Prepare client-ready reports, executive summaries, technical findings, and presentation materials, and support remediation and retesting discussions with stakeholders.
* Contribute to engagement planning, proposal support, delivery optimization, methodology development, and mentoring of junior team members.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber Defense & Resilience teams assist clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystems. Through penetration testing, application security assessments, attack surface management, red teaming, and purple teaming, our professionals help clients understand how threat actors may exploit weaknesses across applications, networks, cloud environments, endpoints, and enterprise systems. The team combines offensive security expertise with practical defensive recommendations. Our work helps clients improve detection, response, remediation, and overall cyber resilience while aligning technical findings to business priorities and risk objectives.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: General**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, application security, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or cyber risk services.
* Experience conducting penetration tests across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, thick-client applications, networks, cloud environments, or enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience performing manual assessment and exploitation of vulnerabilities including SQL injection, cross-site scripting, XML external entity attacks, server-side request forgery, insecure deserialization, HTTP request smuggling, authentication weaknesses, authorization weaknesses, and business logic vulnerabilities.
* Experience performing secure code reviews and threat modeling.
* Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Fiddler, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Qualys, Tenable, Veracode, Frida, Apktool, JADX, dnSpy, or IDA Pro.
* One or more cybersecurity certifications such as Offensive Security Certified Professional, Offensive Security Web Expert, GIAC Penetration Tester, GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, or CREST certification.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with red team, purple team, breach and attack simulation, or adversary emulation engagements.
* Experience assessing Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud environments, including identity and access management, storage, compute, networking, containers, or Kubernetes.
* Experience testing artificial intelligence-enabled applications, large language model integrations, APIs, or agent-based systems.
* Experience developing security testing automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience supporting executive briefings and presenting technical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Publications, blogs, open-source tools, conference presentations, research, or Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures submissions related to cybersecurity.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes. Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics. Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls. title: Security Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
As a Security Automation Engineer I, you will contribute to the growth and maturity of our Security Operations team by developing and maintaining automation playbooks and workflows within our SOAR and XDR platforms. You will be responsible for translating analyst-driven investigation workflows into automation that accelerates triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation of issues across the SOC. A strong background in security operations is essential for this role. Understanding what happens before and after an alert is received is what separates functional automation from automation that reflects how real investigations work. By collaborating closely with SOC analysts and senior engineers, you will help reduce manual workload, improve response consistency, and support a more resilient security operation.
  
  
**Experience**
2+ years of experience as a SOC analyst, with senior analyst experience preferred. Candidates must demonstrate hands-on familiarity with alert triage, threat investigation, and escalation decision-making.
  
  
1-2 years of experience working with a SOAR platform, with Palo Alto XSIAM or XSOAR experience strongly preferred.
  
  
**Education**
Four-year college degree resulting in a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Certifications, Accreditations, Licenses**
**One Or More Of The Following Certifications**
Palo Alto Cortex, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, GIAC GSEC, EC-Council CEH, and similar.
  
  
**Special Knowledge**
The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, common attack techniques, and SOC operational workflows. Candidate will have experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, endpoint protection, and email security technologies. Familiarity with SOAR playbook development is required, with Palo Alto XSIAM and/or XSOAR experience being strongly preferred. Candidates should understand common detection use cases including phishing, endpoint compromise, identity threats, and network anomalies.
  
  
Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation tasks is required. Candidates must be comfortable working with REST APIs, Regex, and JSON to build and troubleshoot platform integrations. Familiarity with Windows, MacOS, and Linux environments is expected.
  
  
**Skills**
Develop, test, and maintain automated playbooks and integrations across Palo Alto XSOAR and Cortex XSIAM. Collaborate with SOC analysts to identify manual, repetitive workflows and translate them into reliable automation. Experience integrating security tools and platforms to support cohesive, automated response workflows.
  
  
Strong analytical skills to evaluate playbook performance, identify logic gaps, and iterate based on analyst feedback and operational data. Effective problem-solving to troubleshoot integration and automation failures.
  
  
Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document playbook logic and contribute to design discussions across distributed teams.
  
  
**Abilities**
Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and stay productive in a remote environment. Must be a collaborative team player capable of contributing to technical conversations and troubleshooting sessions. High attention to detail to ensure automation logic performs accurately under varied conditions.
  
  
Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, detection techniques, and automation capabilities. Ability to adapt playbook logic as the threat landscape and tool stack change over time.

Are you an innovative and accomplished professional seeking for a role with a significant impact and growth? Amazon is looking for a dynamic Software Development Engineer to join our core team in the Books org with a focus on AbeBooks automation and modernization initiatives.
  
  
In this role, you will scope complex projects and deliver simple, elegant solutions by collecting product and business requirements, driving the development schedule from design to release, making appropriate trade-offs to optimize time-to-market, and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional teams. You will interact with a broad cross-section of the Amazon organization, clarify ambiguous issues, and negotiate effective technical solutions between development and business teams. You will anticipate bottlenecks and escalate issues when required to ensure on-time delivery. This role requires a seasoned individual with excellent experience as a Software Development Engineer and the ability to guide high-level technical design.
  
  
If you are excited about solving complex problems, working across diverse teams, and driving operational excellence at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and improve automations that reduce manual effort and modernize existing systems and workflows.
* Continuously improve existing systems, focusing on test coverage, refactoring, and reducing technical debt.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies to solve complex operational challenges.
* Deliver features with agility, contributing to a highly collaborative and innovative team environment.
* Deliver and build software at high bar with respect to quality, security, architecture, scalability and operational excellence.
* Build systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
* Ability to identify the root cause of issues including areas where it limits innovation and prevents accelerated delivery of projects, while navigating several systems and components they may or may not own. Ultimately, they display strong technical acumen and ownership.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of full stack development experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

Global Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives and Structured Products. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies. In addition, GMT provides Sales, Electronic Trading, Trade Work Flow, Pricing, and Market Risk, Middle office, Collateral Management, Credit Risk, Post-trade confirmation, Settlement and Client service processes for Trading, Capital Markets, and Wealth Management businesses.
  
  
FX electronic trading technology contains a suite of applications, with a complex eco system, architecture, multiple business flows, upstream and downstream dependencies. This is a critical institutional front office trading application supported 24 by 5 supporting all global locations for FX business.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The successful candidate will join the India development team of FX electronic trading technology.
  
  
Individual contributor role; is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for solutions at the program or portfolio level to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities include design/delivery of critical strategic complex business projects along with the India team. Continuously improving the design, quality, and reuse of the solution and delivering technology enablers that improve development efficiencies for the solution. They are experts in at least one area of engineering and acts as a "go-to-” reference across the organization. As experts, they play a role in improving technical competency in their area through recruitment and development activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Leads the planning, definition, and design of complex features which span multiple teams and explores solution alternatives.
  
  

* Creates ideas on designing complex technology and solution development approaches - e.g., boundary condition coverage for complex technology issues.
* Help validate the economic impact of design decisions.
* Leads technical oversight for teams in solution development including design reviews and code within own domain.
* Supports/mentors/coaches’ team(s) on design and best practices for high code performance e.g., pairing, code reviews
* Accountable for defining the technology tool stack for the solution within range of internally approved and supported technologies.
* Explores state-of-the-art technologies to improve development efficiencies, quality of test/QA coverage, and release management.
* Leads and is responsible for the end-to-end test strategy/creation/adherence, and the integration between teams for a program/portfolio solution.
* Enables a program/portfolio solution with CI/CD capabilities and release management; Responsible for maximizing reusability, ensuring process optimization and efficient functioning of CI-CD pipeline.
* Optimize and tune existing modules for better performance
* Collaborate with product owners, scrum masters, testing teams throughout the SDLC process.
* Fully leverage AI tools during the SDLC cycle with clear measurable delivery velocity improvements

**Requirements**
**Education:**
Graduate / Postgraduate in Computer Science engineering or equivalent
  
  
**Certifications If Any**
:NA

14-20 years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* Hands-on Software Development in C++ preferably on UNIX/Linux in a distributed application environment
* Strong in C++ application design and development that includes strong multi-threading

**engineering-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands-on engineering, 20–30% governance-related work)**
. The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.

  
  

You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Governance Engineering & Automation**

  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.
  
  
* Translate governance policies into scalable, technical implementations embedded within data platforms (with guidance from senior team members as needed).
  
  
* Together with US-based Data Governance team, develop reusable frameworks and patterns that enable consistent governance adoption across business units.
  

  

**Collibra Platform & Integration**

  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API-based integrations.
  
  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  
  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  

  

**Metadata & Data Catalog Management**

  

  
* Support the build-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  
  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  
  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  

  

**Data Quality Engineering**

  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  
  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  
  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  

  

**Data Compliance, Security & Privacy**

  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  
  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  
  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  

  

**Data Engineering & Integration**

  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  
  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  
  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  

  

**Collaboration & Delivery**

  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand-up meetings with US-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  
  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  
  

**Required (Core Engineering Skills)**

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical field.
  
  
* 3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related roles.
  
  
* Strong programming and data engineering experience (e.g., Python, SQL).
  
  
* Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, microservices).
  
  
* Familiarity with modern cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
  

  

**Preferred (Data Governance & Domain Experience – can be developed on the job)**

  

  
* Understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  
  
* Experience with data governance tools, preferably Collibra.
  
  
* Experience implementing data catalog, lineage, or metadata management solutions.
  
  
* Exposure to data quality frameworks and monitoring tools.
  
  
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance principles (e.g., PII, access controls).
  
  
* Experience designing and implementing data pipelines or integrating data from multiple sources.
  
  
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams.
  

  

**Skills & Attributes**

  

  
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  
  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Self-starter with a focus on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions.

title: WoW Quality Automation Specialist
description:
Join us as a Quality Analyst
  
  

* If you have a keen eye for detail, this could be the role for you, as you’ll make sure that only well designed and built work packages get through quality testing
* You’ll make sure decisions made are based on robust data, return on investment and value measures that demonstrate thoughtful and intelligent cost management
* Joining us in this fast-paced role, you'll have excellent opportunities for progression and developing your analyst capabilities
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Quality Analyst, you’ll be assisting the feature team to define testable work that is technically robust, high performing, stable and secure, and ensures excellent customer experiences and outcomes. Promoting continuous improvement, you’ll identify opportunities to maximise the customer experience and reduce the test cycle time by improving techniques, tooling, eliminating waste and creating a collaborative, proactive approach to quality in the feature team.

* Working in conjunction with quality automation specialists in writing automated tests and analysing the results

* Understanding the customer and human centric designs and driving the quality of the teams work to constantly improve the solutions and enhance customer experiences
* Making sure defects are detected and prioritised, based on impact, and resolved at the earliest possible moment ensuring customer outcomes are delivered right first time

The skills you'll need

You’ll also need experience of systems development lifecycle, along with experience of delivering testing activities in a technology or IT function.
  
  
**Additionally, We’ll Be Looking For**

* Practical experience of testing ideas, products, designs, planning and execution
* Experience in functional and non-functional testing such as system, system integration, user, load, volume, stress, security, accessibility, compatibility, penetration and back-out
* The ability to relate everyday work to the strategic vision of the feature, platform, domain and enterprise teams, with a strong focus on business outcomes
* The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to peers and management
* Good collaboration and stakeholder management skills

title: Sr. Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects.
* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Product Test Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior product test consultant specializing in Facets claims and benefit configuration for healthcare payer and provider solutions in a hybrid work model. Apply deep hands on experience to validate complex configurations optimize claims processing accuracy and ensure system reliability and compliance. Collaborate closely with cross functional teams to deliver robust high quality Facets implementations that improve member and provider experiences while supporting enterprise scale o
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive comprehensive test strategy planning for Facets modules focused on claims adjudication and benefit configuration to ensure end to end coverage across core healthcare payer and provider use cases.
* Design detailed test scenarios and data sets for Facets claims processing including complex benefit rules and provider contract variations to validate accurate outcomes in high volume production environments.
* Execute functional and integration testing on Facets claims workflows to verify proper configuration of benefits accumulators pricing logic and provider networks while minimizing defects reaching production.
* Analyze Facets configuration tables and rule sets to identify potential gaps or conflicts in benefit designs and claims edits and propose corrective changes that improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with business analysts configuration teams and operations stakeholders to translate payer and provider business requirements into testable Facets scenarios that reflect real world claim patterns.
* Perform root cause analysis on defects identified in Facets claims and benefit configuration and document findings in clear test artifacts that enable targeted remediation and future prevention.
* Validate interoperability between Facets and downstream systems such as financial reporting data warehouses and provider portals to ensure claims and benefit data integrity across the ecosystem.
* Apply healthcare payer and provider domain expertise to evaluate the impact of new benefit designs regulatory mandates and product changes on Facets test coverage and regression suites.
* Create and maintain reusable test assets including regression packs test data libraries and execution checklists tailored to Facets claims and benefits modules to support continuous delivery.
* Coordinate test execution in a hybrid work environment ensuring effective communication of progress risks and dependencies across onsite and remote stakeholders during day shift operations.
* Provide mentoring and guidance to peers and junior testers on Facets configuration concepts claims adjudication flows and best practices for healthcare product testing while promoting quality ownership.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by assessing test process performance proposing optimization opportunities and supporting adoption of automation where feasible in Facets testing.
* Document clear and concise test results and business impact summaries highlighting improvements in claim accuracy benefit interpretation and provider satisfaction driven by high quality configuration validation.

**Qualifications**

* Leverage extensive experience of nine to twelve years in product testing with a strong focus on healthcare payer and provider domains to interpret complex requirements and design robust Facets test approaches.
* Apply expert proficiency in Facets claims functionality to validate claim adjudication business rules pricing logic and edits ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration including benefit plans accumulators and eligibility constructs to verify that configured products support diverse member coverage scenarios.
* Demonstrate hands on experience across broader Facets platform capabilities such as membership billing and provider data to ensure holistic validation of integrated health plan operations.
* Use deep domain knowledge in provider networks reimbursement models and contract structures to assess how Facets configurations impact provider claim outcomes and operational workflows.
* Employ strong understanding of payer business processes including enrollment benefits administration and claims lifecycle management to design tests that reflect real health plan operations.
* Apply familiarity with hybrid work practices and day shift collaboration models to maintain effective stakeholder engagement clear communication and consistent delivery of test commitments.

title: Senior Discipline Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Security-Focused Development**

* ECU Architecture: Define robust software architectures for vehicle ECUs with a strong focus on cybersecurity and functional safety (ISO 26262/ASIL).
* Agile Development: Lead architectural sprints within an Agile framework, ensuring incremental delivery of high-quality, security-compliant software features.
* MBD Strategy: Enforce MAAB Guidelines and ensure model compliance for efficient Code Generation (Embedded Coder) and seamless integration into the target hardware.

**Simulation & Evaluation Environment (MILS/HILS)**

* Environment Creation: Architect and deploy evaluation environments for ADAS features using Model-in-the-Loop (MILS) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HILS) simulations.
* Scenario Design: Design complex test scenarios based on functional specifications using CarMaker or CarSim, replicating real-world driving conditions.
* Data-Driven Validation: Develop test cases for MILS/HILS derived from real driving data, ensuring the virtual environment accurately reflects physical road behavior.

**Automation & Verification**

* Test Automation: Automate the execution of test scenarios and regression suites to accelerate the validation loop (utilizing Python/MATLAB scripts).
* Logic Verification: Verify control logic robustness through rigorous MILS/HILS testing before physical vehicle integration.
* Toolchain Management: Manage the integration of verification tools (dSPACE ControlDesk, Vector CANoe) into the architectural workflow.

**Domain Expertise (ADAS)**
*You must have experience architecting or developing at least one of the following features:*

* Automatic Parking (APA/RPA)
* Advanced Emergency Braking System (AEBS)
* Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
* Lane Departure Control / Prevention System (LDW/LKA/LDP)

**Key Qualifications**
**Software & Tools Proficiency**

* MBD Core: Expert in MATLAB and Simulink.
* Code Generation: Strong proficiency in Embedded Coder for production code generation.
* Simulation Tools: Hands-on experience with CarMaker or CarSim for vehicle dynamics simulation.
* Validation Tools: Proficiency with dSPACE ControlDesk and Vector CANoe / CAPL scripting.
* Automation: High proficiency in Python for scripting, data analysis, and test automation.

**Competencies**

* MILS/HILS Verification: proven track record in setting up and executing virtual verification (MILS) and hardware-in-the-loop (HILS) tests.
* Standards: Deep knowledge of MAAB Guidelines, ISO 26262, and ASIL (Automotive Safety Integrity Level) classification.
* Soft Skills:

Strong analytical and conceptual thinking to solve complex architectural conflicts.
  
  
Effective communication skills to present technical concepts to stakeholders.
  
  
Team-oriented mindset with the ability to mentor junior engineers.
  
  
**Education & Experience**

* Degree: B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Mechatronics, or Computer Science.
* Experience: 7+ years in Embedded Software, with specific exposure to ADAS features, Vehicle ECU Architecture, and Simulation environments.

title: Senior Internet of Things Engineer
description:

* Build services for device onboarding, telemetry ingestion, device management, and command/control workflows.
* Develop distributed, real-time communication components integrating Edge, HTTPS, and REST APIs.
* Own successful implementation and delivery of software products and components throughout the product lifecycle, on time and with high quality.
* Assure proper technical requirement definition with internal and external customers, marketing, manufacturing, and other support groups.
* Lead technical design and architecture reviews, and participate in prototyping activities.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Embedded, Mobile Apps, IT, Hardware, QA, Manufacturing, Technical Support, and Operations teams.
* Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
* Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization's intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
* Mentor and train other engineers.
* Having Open mindset to work with legacy network libraries in IoT domain
* More curious to learn any Open Source libraries

**Education Requirements**

* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent is required.
* MS in Computer Science/Computer Engineering or equivalent is preferred.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **10+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on IoT and embedded systems.**
* Proficiency in C++ developing distributed, real-time applications.
* 5+ years of experience with multithreaded application development and debugging.
* 5+ years of experience with socket-level TCP and UDP development in C/C++, using modern debugging tools.
* Strong understanding of software design principles and best practices; ability to develop unit-test-driven software components.

**Cloud & IoT**

* Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and standards: MQTT, WebSockets, HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON/XML.
* Experience with cloud IoT services such as Azure IoT Hub and AWS IoT Core.
* Strong understanding of device-to-cloud integration.

**Linux & Debugging**

* Strong Linux Ubuntu skills, including creating and maintaining system services and navigating the system using Bash.
* Strong skills monitoring and managing Linux services and troubleshooting service failures using gdb, coredumps, trace files, and log files.
* Strong networking skills (TCP, UDP, ARP, IGMP) with the ability to monitor and debug on a live system.
* Strong experience using SSH to access and manage systems in the cloud.
* Strong Bash shell script authoring and maintenance.

**Network & Home Router**

* Strong understanding of Network Address Translation (NAT), network handshakes, and Round-Trip Time (RTT) analysis and debugging.
* Strong understanding of Publisher-Subscriber (Pub-Sub) frameworks in the IoT domain, including MQTT brokers, DDS (Data Distribution Service) standards, message queuing systems, and streaming platforms.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, clustering, and middleware concepts.
* Strong understanding of client-server and Pub-Sub application development, packaging, deployment, and execution, including Debian packages (.deb) and standalone executable binaries.

**Tools**

* Strong skills with Git and GitLab.
* Experience with Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio with WSL.
* Experience with Configuration Management tools (version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
* Experience with JetBrains CLion is a plus.
* Remote debugging skills using gdb and gdbserver are a plus.
* Experience with Artitellery or any load test framework is a puls

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with OpenDDS or another Data Distribution Service (DDS) middleware.
* Experience with at least one other high-level language, such as C#, Java, Python, or Node.js.
* Microservices architecture, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* CI/CD experience (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Experience developing and deploying cloud applications on Microsoft Azure, with emphasis on: Virtual Machine Scale Sets; load balancing; Syslog and Azure Metrics reporting and monitoring reports; network VM maintenance planning and monitoring. Multi-region and availability-zone VMSS experience is a plus.
* Azure DevOps Boards, Backlogs, Sprints, and Plans; ability to understand an Azure DevOps pipeline and the concepts it holds.
* Experience with edge computing platforms.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Digital Payments and Emerging Markets
description:
**Description**
What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you’re passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase.
* Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems.

A day in the life
  
  
You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable.
  
  
We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.
  
  
The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Network Management Testing
  
  

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

Test Planning and Execution
  
  

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API Cloud and Data Validation
  
  

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.
* Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

Networking and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.
* Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.
* Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.
* Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

Test Automation
  
  

* Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.
* Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.
* Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.
* Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.
* Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

Defect Management and Team Collaboration
  
  

* Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.
* Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.
* Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly.
* Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools.

Release and Production Support
  
  

* Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned.
* Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead.
* Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments.
* Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience.
* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts.
* Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data.
* Programming or test-automation experience using Python.
* Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool.
* Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports.
* Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms.
* Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments.
* Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis.
* Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing.
* Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts.
* Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot for test design, automation, debugging or log analysis.

**Company Statement/Values**
At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.
  
  
We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the
*Next Gear*
by living our values: we
**Dare to Transform**
the future,
**Connect and Delight**
our customers,
**Communicate Courageously**
with each other and collaborate to
**Win It Together**
. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.
  
  
We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.
  
  
*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
  
  
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
  
  
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics & System trend analysis

**Typical Skills And Background**

* 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
* Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
* Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
* AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Quality Automation Specialist
description:

Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you’ll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You’ll make sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. * API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management

* Effective communication and collaboration with global teams
* Ability to work in fast-paced consulting environments
* Continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging AI trends

title: Engineer - Software
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Software Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in software design, development, and maintenance of enterprise\-grade applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong logical and analytical thinking, excellent programming skills, and a passion for building high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

 The candidate will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and support software products throughout the product development lifecycle. This role requires strong technical ownership, problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to contribute effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.
   

  

 Success in this position requires effective collaboration, a strong drive to achieve project objectives, and the ability to learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and processes. Experience in media\-related applications, video streaming, surveillance systems, or Video Management Systems (VMS) will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain software applications to meet business and customer requirements.
* Develop robust, reusable, and maintainable automation solutions using C\# .NET.
* Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into robust software solutions.
* Participate in software architecture, design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision\-making.
* Develop scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance applications following software engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Ensure software quality through unit testing, integration testing, and adherence to coding standards.
* Contribute to automation initiatives.
* Take technical ownership of assigned modules and ensure successful delivery.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Design, develop, and maintain software applications using .NET Framework / .NET Core
* Develop and support applications related to CCTV / video surveillance.
* Work on video streaming, processing, and real\-time data handling
* Integrate third\-party SDKs and multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer
* Develop and maintain interop layers between .NET applications and native C\+\+ libraries using C\+\+/CLI
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including hardware, firmware, and QA teams
* Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical documentation
* Support product enhancements, bug fixes, and sustaining engineering activities
* Ensure compliance with performance, scalability, and security standards.

title: WLAN Performance Testing - Staff Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: Specialist, Software Technology
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

 KLA's eBeam Division is looking for passionate software developers to join us and help define and deliver high\-quality solutions for our current generation and next generation products in our Wafer Inspection and Review product lines. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be responsible to build software solutions for the machine control software of our products which would have a direct impact on the semi\-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all.
   

  

 You will fit right in if you have a good understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science. Are you somebody who enjoys working on complex software, is very keen on understanding customer use cases and enjoys, understands the big picture? You will work with exceptional talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to learn, contribute and collaborate in developing end\-to\-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on learning and applying clean coding practices. Having a keen interest and ability to analyze problems and tackle them would be critical in this role.
   

  

 Knowledge of Object\-Oriented software analysis and design, Microsoft .Net or C\+\+ programming would also be important.
   

  

* Be responsible for the analysis of current software systems for performance, throughput, diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems and comping developing solutions that address these issues.
* Be responsible for developing prototypes and working on solutions for new concepts.
* Implement machine control software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions.
* Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource intensive software requirements to optimize and enhance performance of the hardware system. Good software documentation skills are required.
* Be willing to learn new design principles, technologies and business use\-cases is essential.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 KLA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.
   

  

 We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
   

  

 KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
